# sevenai

> sevenai is an AI creative studio that produces 9:16 UGC video ads for e-commerce brands. Brands send a product URL; sevenai delivers 10 campaign-ready creatives in 24–48 hours for $549 (launch offer).

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://sevenaii.com/): Offer overview, mock format examples, FAQ, and brief form.
- [How it works](https://sevenaii.com/how-it-works): Four steps — briefing, hook strategy, AI generation, 24–48h delivery.
- [Traditional UGC vs AI UGC](https://sevenaii.com/ugc-vs-ai-ugc): Production cost, turnaround, shipping, and rights. Not a CAC or ROAS guarantee.
- [Creative Testing Sprint](https://sevenaii.com/creative-testing-sprint): $549 for 10 videos ($54.90/file). What is included and what is not.
- [About](https://sevenaii.com/about): Studio scope, contact, and what sevenai does not claim.

## Key Facts

- Offer: Creative Testing Sprint — 10 videos for $549 USD ($54.90 per video), first 10 brands
- Turnaround: 24 to 48 hours after brief approval
- Format: 9:16 for TikTok Shop, TikTok Ads, Meta Reels, YouTube Shorts
- Rights: perpetual commercial usage included
- Shipping: none
- Claims: we publish production pricing, not unverified CPM/ROAS case studies
- Contact: hello@sevenaii.com
